mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 47 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park, and we have a beautiful waning gibbous moon phase. Also, keep an eye out tonight at 5:51 PM, as the International Space Station will be visible, moving from the northwest over Verona High School high into the sky toward the southeast near Festival Foods.

City news today focuses on the 2027 Spring Election, as candidate packets are now available for the four Aldermanic District seats. You must file your declaration of candidacy and nomination papers with the City Clerk by 5 PM on January 5, 2027.
There is a lot happening in our community. Bailey's Run Vineyard hosts live music today, while tomorrow features the Verona Crafty Fair at ART House 360 and live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on November 4, a 34-year-old woman was arrested for O W I following a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Flavor of the Day, Snickers Swirl. The shop is open now and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
